feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.description: Report a problem or suggest an improvement to Uocode Client.
feedback.subject: Subject
feedback.detailsPlaceholder: What happened? Include the steps to reproduce and the result you expected.
feedback.contactPlaceholder: Email or another way to reach you
feedback.dataNotice: Your submission includes only the subject, issue description, optional contact and client version ({{version}}). API keys and passwords are never collected automatically.
feedback.sent: Your suggestion was recorded. Thank you.
feedback.connectionHelp: This build uses its configured Feishu / Lark destination; no Webhook entry is needed in the client. Signature verification is not supported; if keyword verification is enabled, allow “Uocode Client feedback”.
feedback.localConfig: Saved on this device only. Clear the field and save to remove the destination.
feedback.saved: Destination saved. Delivery will be checked when you submit feedback.
feedback.error.invalidWebhook: Enter a valid Feishu or Lark custom bot Webhook URL.
feedback.error.invalidTitle: Use at least 5 characters for the title.
feedback.error.invalidDetails: Use at least 15 characters and describe the issue clearly.
feedback.error.invalidContact: Contact must be 200 characters or fewer.
feedback.error.network: Could not send. Check your network and try again; your draft is preserved.
feedback.error.rejected: The bot rejected the message. Check the Webhook and bot security settings.
feedback.error.response: The bot returned an unrecognized response. Delivery could not be confirmed.
feedback.error.desktopOnly: Send feedback from the desktop app.
feedback.error.notConfigured: This build has no Feishu destination configured. Contact the administrator.
feedback.error.storage: Could not save the destination on this device.

keys.rateHelp: Input is the base model multiplier; output is relative to input. Charges also apply the group multiplier. Per-request prices are base prices; dynamic billing follows its pricing rules.
